notes: shall be goes to מָה as the clause's predicate under rule 20's מִי הָאִישׁ הַלָּזֶה reading; putting it on אָשָׁם, the clause's subject, is the competing analysis.
was on is the prepositional predicate of the כִּי clause and heads on the לְ (rule 49); the suffix takes you and כֹּל keeps only all, since the ASV writes no of (rule 19).
